arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

t530 = parse.FixedTzOffset(-5 * 60 - 30, '-5:30')
print(f't530 offset: {t530.utcoffset(None)}')

fmt = 'a {:tt} b'
s = 'a 10:21:36 PM -530 b'
r = parse.parse(fmt, s)
if r:
    dt = r.fixed[0]
    print(f'dt.tzinfo: {dt.tzinfo}')
    print(f'dt.tzinfo.utcoffset: {dt.tzinfo.utcoffset(None)}')
    print(f'Match: {dt.tzinfo == t530}')
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
